title: Integrations release communication runbook and portal update
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable runbook and update the Integrations section of the Customer Portal to coordinate release notes and go-to-market communications specifically for third-party integration updates. This ticket covers drafting the customer-facing changelog copy, an internal signoff flow, a triage plan for last-minute API/deprecation notes, and templates for partner emails and partner-facing docs.
acceptance_criteria: A complete customer-facing changelog snippet for Integrations is drafted and approved by Legal, Security, and Partner Ops.
Internal release playbook (step-by-step) is published to Confluence and linked from the portal admin checklist.
Signoff matrix with named approvers and SLA for responses (48 business hours) is documented.
Portal 'Integrations' page updated with the new changelog section and migration guidance, verified in staging and prod preview.
All partner email templates and webhook migration notes are included and reviewed by Partner Ops.
Rollout plan includes fallback messaging for breaking changes and a post-release monitoring dashboard link.
At least one cross-functional review meeting completed with minutes and follow-up items assigned.
reviewers: Daniel Chen - security and deprecation guidance
Keiko Tanaka - copy edit and tone
customer_changelog_draft: Integrations: Added adaptive retry semantics for webhook deliveries to reduce duplicate events under transient errors (impact: behavioral, opt-in for partners).
Integrations: Introduced 'auth_v2' header for improved key rotation — see migration notes and automated rotation tool in Partner Portal.
Integrations: Fixed edge case where callback URLs containing query fragments were incorrectly normalized (no action required).
Deprecation notice: Legacy OAuth token exchange endpoint (/v1/auth/exchange) will be deprecated on 2026-06-01. See migration steps and SDK snippets.
internal_release_note: Reasoning: auth_v2 enables per-key rotation and reduces blast radius for compromised keys. Engineering recommends 1-week pilot with top 10 partners.
Rollout strategy: Canary to 5% of integrations first, monitor webhook failure rate and delivery latency. Fallback: auto-retry policy switches to legacy semantics if error spike > 2x baseline.
Monitoring: dashboard 'Integrations / Webhook Delivery' updated with new alerts; runbook entry created for alert 'webhook.delivery.latency > 5s for 5m'.
Rollback: configuration toggles in Dedicated and Hosted consoles; SRE runbook for toggling and confirming cache invalidation.
signoff_checklist: Draft changelog text approved by Legal
Security review completed and staged recommendations implemented
Engineering confirms migration sample scripts and SDK snippets are live in docs
Partner Ops approves partner email and notification cadence
Marketing provides final subject lines and placement in the release announcement
Documentation updated in docs.redwood.ai and validated in staging
Portal integration widget updated and QA green in staging
